text:
anika: Quick sync — planning a focused base-image rebuild + runtime lockdown Friday 01:00-03:00 UTC. Scope: strip unused interpreters, enable rootless container runtime flags, rotate the image-signer creds, migrate signer to KMS-wrap. Affects Dedicated & Private clusters.

sam: OK. RBAC changes? will this touch workload identity or cloud bindings?

anika: We'll create a confined k8s SA `infra:image-signer` and a Role limited to reading signing secrets and listing deployments in infra namespace. No cluster-admin. Canary will get a namespaced RoleBinding only.

liam: KMS note: signer requires `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key. I'll open IAM request to grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the signer principal. HSM not required for initial rollout.

maria: Requirements: 1) audit logging — capture signing calls and RBAC changes and ship to Splunk with 365d retention; 2) vuln gating — fail canary promotion on any CRITICAL or if HIGH > 5.

kevin: For audit we'll add policy matches for requests by `system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer` and for rbac.authorization.k8s.io writes, capturing RequestBody. Also add a logging sidecar to forward /var/log/signer.log to secure-splunk.

ops: Paging plan: ops-oncall if signer_error_rate > 1% or signer_p95 > 500ms for 5m. We'll pre-create a read-only image cache so pulls don't block if signing hiccups.

sam: CI flow: create canary RoleBinding with ephemeral CI creds: `kubectl create rolebinding signer-canary-binding --role=image-signer-role --serviceaccount=infra:image-signer --namespace=canary`. Apply from `ci/infra` runner. Do not delete old bindings until 48h stable.

maria: I'll add SBOM (Syft SPDX) generation and trivy scan in preflight. Upload SBOM to artifact-store with checksum. Fail promotion on policy.

anika: Canary runbook: build minimal image -> SBOM -> scan -> deploy to fenced canary -> monitor 24h -> rollback on scan/telemetry fail. Key metrics: signer_latency_p50/p95, signer_error_rate, image_pull_errors, container_start_failures.

liam: IAM ticket CLOUD-1833 opened for KMS grant. ETA ~6h. Signer config snippet will point to `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signing-2026` with wrap=kms.

kevin: I'll author the audit-policy PR and include tests asserting audit events for `system:serviceaccount:infra:image-signer`.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: base-image-lockdown-2026-06-11 at 2026-06-11T01:00:00Z (initiated by anika). Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/base/minimal:20260611-canary.

anika: Action items recap: sam=RBAC playbook + CI job; liam=IAM + signer config; maria=SBOM + scans; kevin=audit-policy PR + Splunk pipeline; ops=on-call + fallback cache. Reconvene Thu EOD for final sign-off. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
